scope: source-preserving textarea edits, three-way review/suggestions, undoable disk reload and guarded deleted-resource recovery
checks: disjoint scalar/object additions/removals, adjacent source ranges, escaped keys and already-applied changes preserve exact source tokens
overlapping atomic arrays/scalars and invalid/duplicate inputs withhold suggestions; textarea edits preserve BOM/mixed unchanged newlines and use existing inserted-line style
actual raw/fragment textarea paths retain original line endings, unknown fields and exact number tokens
actual versioned local file conflict uses an explicitly chosen complete suggestion; reload changes no disk file and preserves undo; stale/cancelled reviews retain newer edits
deleted-file recreation uses the absent-path condition; a competing create forces a second review and cannot be overwritten; confirmed recreation succeeds
limits: One tiny actual PackStore file, six small structural cases and controlled Node textarea/modal/application hosts. Suggestions are bounded proposals, not authoritative semantic/native merges; arrays and type changes remain atomic, source trivia/order follows disk and no partial candidate is published on conflict. Manual reviewed source remains available. Native textarea focus/input/IME/undo/newline/paste/layout/network interleaving, browser/IndexedDB/multi-tab and native/client/release qualification remain pending. No native build/generation, registry/state sweep, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow.
